item.title: Lavazza announces new regional leadership for key European markets
item.description: The appointment will lead wholesale and direct-to-consumer sales for the Italian coffee roaster across Central Europe Turin-based Lavazza has announced new regional leadership for four major European markets.

item.title: Analysis: More UK coffee operators are doing drive-thru, but is there consumer appetite for it?
item.description: World Coffee Portal research shows that nearly half of UK coffee shop consumers surveyed last year ordered from a drive-thru. Could the format be the next frontier of growth in the £6.8bn UK branded coffee shop market?

item.title: The Week in Coffee: 16-22 March 2026
item.description: Your weekly round-up of 5 essential coffee industry stories you won’t want to miss... * UK’s The Coffee House bags second multi-million-pound investment * Nespresso makes its biggest play yet for Gen Z consumers with new Global Brand Ambassador * Tchibo takes legal dispute over supermarket coffee discounting to Germany’s

item.title: Tim Hortons sees a gap for QSR-style food in the UK branded coffee shop market
item.description: The Canadian coffee chain’s latest move comes less than two weeks after it made a two-decade commitment to the UK and Ireland

item.title: The US drive-thru coffee market is getting a new competitor
item.description: The move marks the first time a US convenience chain has launched a standalone drive-thru coffee concept

item.title: Starbucks seeks a greater slice of the UK premium bakery segment
item.description: The US coffee chain has debuted a new high-end cake and patisserie menu in the UK to increase ticket size and become a brand for all occasions

item.title: Episode 204: The impact of deforestation on coffee production
item.description: In today’s episode we’re exploring how climate change and deforestation are impacting global coffee production, with Dr. Aaron Davis, Senior Research Leader for Crops & Global Change at The Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew. Aaron has spent more than three decades researching coffee species and is a leading voice

item.title: China’s Mixue Group finds fortune with fast-growing Lucky Cup
item.description: The ultra-affordable coffee chain is gaining ground on Chinese market leaders, Luckin Coffee and Cotti Coffee, while pursuing international growth

item.title: Hemro Group appoints 2017 World Barista Champion as new Brand Ambassador
item.description: Dale Harris is one of only three representatives from the UK to win the coveted WBC title after his victory in Seoul, South Korea

item.title: Chobani announces $567m investment in La Colombe specialty coffee business
item.description: The US dairy group acquired Philadelphia-based La Colombe for $900m in December 2023 US dairy giant Chobani is making a major investment in its La Colombe specialty coffee business.
